users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone who signed in to the hub: profile, joined products, and payments.
users.emptyDescription: Users appear here after their first Google sign-in.

detail.title: User
detail.productsDescription: Products this user has opened through the hub.
detail.noProducts: This user has not joined a product yet.

picker.title: Filter by user
picker.description: Search by name or email, then pick a user.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: All payments. Filter by user, product, status, and date to monitor revenue or investigate a problem.
transactions.search: Search by order ID or email
transactions.emptyDescription: Transactions appear here when users check out.

filters.invertedRange: The start date is after the end date, so the date filter is ignored.

detail.description: Payment details and every status change.
detail.reviewDescription: The hub flagged it while applying a Midtrans status (for example, the paid amount did not match the price). Check it in the Midtrans dashboard.
detail.noSubscription: No subscription is linked to this transaction.
detail.historyDescription: Oldest first. Source shows who changed the status.
detail.syncNote: Use “Sync with Midtrans” when a status looks stuck, e.g. a webhook was missed.

products.title: Products
products.description: SaaS products connected to the hub. Adding one is configuration only: product, plans, client credentials, and redirect URIs.
products.emptyDescription: Create a product to connect a new SaaS app to the hub.

form.createDescription: The first client credential is created with the product. Its secret is shown once.
form.editDescription: The code cannot change, because products use it in URLs.
form.codeHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and “-”. It cannot be changed later.
form.websiteHint: Where users open the product. Optional.
form.activeHint: Inactive products are hidden from the public site and cannot be bought.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: What users can buy. Plans are never deleted; deactivate a plan to stop selling it.
plans.emptyDescription: Add at least one plan so users can subscribe.
plans.formDescription: One payment buys one billing period of access; it does not renew automatically.
plans.codeHint: Used in the checkout URL. It cannot be changed later.
plans.codeLocked: The plan code cannot be changed.
plans.priceHint: Whole rupiah. Use 0 for a free plan.
plans.periodHint: Paid plans need a period; a free plan has none.
plans.featuresHint: A JSON object (max 8 KB). The product decides what the keys mean.
plans.publicHint: Shown on the public product page.
plans.soldTitle: Price and billing period are locked
plans.soldDescription: This plan has already been sold. Create a new plan to change the price.
plans.freeExists: This product already has an active free plan. The hub allows only one.

credentials.title: Client credentials
credentials.description: The product uses these to call the hub API. Up to {{max}} can be active, so you can rotate a secret without downtime.
credentials.limit: The limit of {{max}} active credentials is reached. Revoke one to create another.
credentials.lastOne: The last credential cannot be revoked. Create a new one first.
credentials.revokeDescription: Calls signed with {{clientId}} stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
credentials.secretDescription: Store it in the product's secret manager now.
credentials.secretOnce: This secret is shown only once. If you lose it, create a new credential.

redirects.title: SSO redirect URIs
redirects.description: Where the hub may send users back after SSO sign-in. Must match exactly.
redirects.hint: Absolute HTTPS URI, no “#” or wildcard. http://localhost works only when the API allows it.
redirects.empty: No redirect URIs yet. SSO sign-in will fail until one is added.
redirects.removeDescription: SSO sign-ins that return to {{uri}} will be refused.
redirects.duplicate: This redirect URI is already registered.

errors.codeFormat: Use lowercase letters a–z, numbers, and “-” only.
errors.periodRequired: A paid plan needs a billing period.
errors.periodFree: A free plan has no billing period.
errors.featuresJson: Enter a JSON object, e.g. {"removeAds": true}.
errors.featuresTooLarge: Features must be at most 8 KB.

uri.absolute: Enter an absolute URI, e.g. https://app.example.com/callback.
uri.https: Use https:// (http is allowed for localhost only).
